subject: TF-0423 long-lived session loading and label hydration regression

criteria.statement: sessions.summaries reads only bounded head/tail per transcript and bounds one request.
criteria.note: Renderer label hydration is capped at 40 newest sessions; the Main service additionally dedupes and caps a request at 100 keys.

criteria.statement: Only a 64 KiB head and 128 KiB tail per transcript are read; sessions.json is read once per agent; worker concurrency is 8.
At most 40 labels per sweep, batches of 40, and no implicit re-sweep within 30 seconds.
loadSessions and session switching report repeatable P50/P95 on the synthetic set.
criteria.note: Wall-clock UI-observable timings; run-to-run variance on this host is material and the numbers are recorded as samples, not as a cross-platform benchmark.

criteria.statement: Opening a long session must not produce a renderer long task over 50 ms.
criteria.note: Final same-probe run on Windows Electron with 333 synthetic sessions. Sidebar windowing mounts 80 rows per chunk; opening a large session adds 0 long tasks and the idle control is 0, so the absolute >50 ms acceptance threshold is met.

criteria.statement: A five-minute idle RSS curve must not show persistent monotonic growth.
